milestone: browser-style settings pages for global settings, repository settings, and stash manager
expectedUiState: Settings opens with a horizontal browser tab lane, close controls, new-page picker, overflow/search actions, and a linked active panel.
Repository Settings uses the same browser tab chrome and scopes open-page and pin state to the repository.
Stash Manager uses the same browser tab chrome for Manage, Export, History, and Appearance and voice.

Open Repository Settings and inspect the browser tab strip.
